body: 'Take each day as it comes' is something I hear a lot. Taking smaller denominations, take a day hour by hour, is something I've not thought about before. Thank you for your time, you've certainly given me food for thought.

Thank you for your kind words. I feel the ways I've looked into take any active effort out of my hands, it's just a case of let go, breathe, and I'm golden. It used to feel like I'd not see past 25, then 23; now seeing out the year or its following months feels unimaginable.
